name: powershell-lsp
description: Real-time PowerShell diagnostics in Claude Code: as Claude edits a .ps1/.psm1/.psd1, it runs PowerShell Editor Services + PSScriptAnalyzer over that file and surfaces syntax errors and lint fixes inline. Hover, go-to-definition, and find-references serve natively through an opt-in handshake shim (userConfig nativeServe, off by default).

ps_host.title: PowerShell host executable
ps_host.description: Executable used to host PowerShell Editor Services. Recommended: 'pwsh' (PowerShell 7+, the default, tested) or 'powershell' (Windows PowerShell 5.1). See docs/configuration.md#ps_host.

severityThreshold.title: Severity threshold
severityThreshold.description: Least-severe level to report; more-severe levels are always included. Values: 'Error', 'Warning', 'Information', 'Hint' (default). See docs/configuration.md#severitythreshold.

ruleInclude.title: Include rules (comma-separated)
ruleInclude.description: If set, report ONLY these comma-separated PSScriptAnalyzer rule codes (e.g. 'PSUseApprovedVerbs,PSAvoidUsingCmdletAliases'); empty (default) = all. See docs/configuration.md#ruleinclude.

ruleExclude.title: Exclude rules (comma-separated)
ruleExclude.description: Comma-separated PSScriptAnalyzer rule codes to suppress (e.g. 'PSAvoidUsingWriteHost'); empty (default) = none. See docs/configuration.md#ruleexclude.

timeoutMs.title: Client hard cap (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Total milliseconds the PostToolUse client waits before degrading to log-only. Default 5000. See docs/configuration.md#timeoutms.

debounceMs.title: Debounce window (ms)
debounceMs.description: Edits landing within this many milliseconds fold into one analysis pass. Default 150. See docs/configuration.md#debouncems.

keepLastN.title: Log files kept per family
keepLastN.description: SessionStart sweeps each rolling log family down to this many newest files. Default 10. See docs/configuration.md#keeplastn.

idleTtlMin.title: Daemon idle TTL (minutes)
idleTtlMin.description: The daemon self-terminates after this many minutes with no diagnostics request. Default 30. See docs/configuration.md#idlettlmin.

perFileCap.title: Max diagnostics per file
perFileCap.description: Max diagnostics reported per file; the rest collapse into an 'and N more' line. '0' = no cap. Default 20. See docs/configuration.md#perfilecap.

enableStats.title: Enable telemetry/stats
enableStats.description: Append one JSONL timing line per analyzed edit to logs/stats.jsonl; observe-only, never changes diagnostics. Values: 'false' (default), 'true'. See docs/configuration.md#enablestats.

settingsPath.title: PSScriptAnalyzerSettings.psd1 path (override)
settingsPath.description: Absolute path to a PSScriptAnalyzerSettings.psd1 to honor, overriding auto-discovery; a relative value is ignored. Empty (default) = auto-discover. See docs/configuration.md#settingspath.

scopeToEdit.title: Scope diagnostics to the edited lines
scopeToEdit.description: Filter surfaced diagnostics to the lines the edit touched; fails open to whole-file when the range is unknown. Values: 'true' (default), 'false'. See docs/configuration.md#scopetoedit.

editContextLines.title: Edit-scope context lines
editContextLines.description: Extra context lines kept above and below the touched range when scopeToEdit is on; raise to widen the window. Default 0. See docs/configuration.md#editcontextlines.

formatOnEdit.title: Format-on-edit suggestion
formatOnEdit.description: Invoke-Formatter after edits: 'suggest' surfaces a diff only; 'apply' performs a guarded write-back. Values: 'off' (default), 'suggest', 'apply'. See docs/configuration.md#formatonedit.

ruleset.title: Live diagnostics ruleset
ruleset.description: Rule set on the live edit path when no repo settings resolve. Values: 'pses-default' (default), 'base' (broader shipped set). See docs/configuration.md#ruleset.

moduleAwareness.title: Module awareness (uninstalled-module hint)
moduleAwareness.description: Hints when the edited file calls a command from a known module that is not installed on this machine. Values: 'off' (default), 'suggest'. See docs/configuration.md#moduleawareness.

nativeServe.title: Native LSP serve (hover / go-to-definition / find-references)
nativeServe.description: Native nav (hover, go-to-definition, find-references) via a stdio shim around upstream #1359; 'off' is a byte-exact relay. Values: 'off' (default), 'shim'. See docs/configuration.md#nativeserve.

referenceSurfacing.title: Reference surfacing (workspace reference counts)
referenceSurfacing.description: Surfaces bare per-function facts (referenced-by-N, exported, defined-in) from a session workspace index. Values: 'off' (default), 'counts'. See docs/configuration.md#referencesurfacing.
